import subprocess

def main():
    # 综合系统状态检查命令
    cmd = (
        "top -b -n1 | head -n10 && "
        "free -h && "
        "df -h && "
        "whoami && "
        "id && "
        "git --version && "
        "curl -Is https://github.com | head -n1"
    )
    # 使用 shell 以支持管道和 && 组合
    result = subprocess.run(
        cmd,
        shell=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        text=True,
    )
    print(result.stdout)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
